arguments.body:
Hi Tauhid,

I’m sorry, but the size S Classic Bulldog Tee is currently out of stock, so I can’t confirm a restock date yet. We’re arranging a restock and will follow up when we have an update. If you’d prefer, sizes M or L are currently available at $28 each. Please let us know what works best.

Campus Customs Customer Service
